# domainchief_web_redirect (Resource)

Manages a web redirect of a domain that uses Domain Chief hosted DNS. Domain Chief creates the DNS records the redirect needs.

Requires a token with the `domainchief:redirects_web:write` scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Redirect example.com and www.example.com to another site.
resource "domainchief_web_redirect" "root" {
  domain = "example.com"
  target = "https://www.example.net"
}

# Redirect docs.example.com, keeping the requested path.
resource "domainchief_web_redirect" "docs" {
  domain       = "example.com"
  subdomain    = "docs"
  target       = "https://docs.example.net"
  status_code  = 308
  include_path = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The domain name or domain ID the redirect belongs to. Changing this creates a new redirect.
- `target` (String) The URL to redirect to, starting with `http://` or `https://`.

### Optional

- `include_path` (Boolean) Whether the requested path is appended to the target URL. Defaults to `false`.
- `include_query` (Boolean) Whether the requested query string is appended to the target URL. Defaults to `true`.
- `include_www` (Boolean) Whether the `www` subdomain is redirected together with the domain itself. Only applies when `subdomain` is unset. Defaults to `true` for the domain itself and `false` for a subdomain.
- `status_code` (Number) The HTTP status code of the redirect, one of `301`, `302`, `307` or `308`. Defaults to `301`.
- `subdomain` (String) The subdomain to redirect, for example `docs`. Leave unset to redirect the domain itself. Changing this creates a new redirect.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the web redirect.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Web redirects are imported using the domain and the redirect ID.
terraform import domainchief_web_redirect.docs example.com/01HXYZ0000000000000000000
```
